doc: Display sizes identify the standard iPhone 15. Native resolution uses display pixels. Window dimensions, logical screen sizes and safe-area insets use CSS pixels. Each window records the evidence for its usable viewport and insets.

standalone.measured: Landscape Home Screen app, build 28106: inner, client, fixed box and visual viewport all 852x393 at DPR 3. Both standalone flags true. env() insets L59 T0 R59 B20.
standalone.assumed: The preset reproduces this observed landscape window. Other orientations and device states can differ.
standalone.verified: Home Screen app size and insets measured on the owner’s iPhone over the phone bridge (#6049).

portrait.measured: Full-display dimensions match the standard iPhone 15 device profile.
portrait.assumed: Full-screen viewport and safe-area insets for the portrait capture. The Safari toolbar can change the usable viewport.
portrait.source: iPhone 15 display sources above and title-screen emulation for PR #5977
portrait.verified: Full-screen portrait emulation. Insets assumed for the Home Screen app.

safari.measured: Landscape Safari tab: inner = documentElement.client = visualViewport = 852x368 at scale 1 and DPR 3; screen.width/height returned 393x852. The portrait hello in the same session reported inner 393x695.
safari.assumed: insets (env() was not read; the original 59/0/59/21 emulation values are retained) and the toolbar state (expanded or collapsed was not recorded)
safari.verified: Safari tab. Size MEASURED on his iPhone over the phone bridge 2026-11-10 02:40Z (#5218, DPR 3); tab insets ASSUMED for this 368 px state

safari-short.measured: 2026-11-21 Safari tab, both standalone flags false: inner, client, visual viewport and fixed box 852x283 CSS px at scale 1 and DPR 3. svh and dvh 283, vh and lvh 393. env() insets L59 T0 R59 B20.
safari-short.assumed: The browser toolbar position was not recorded.
safari-short.verified: Short Safari viewport and all four insets measured on the owner's iPhone, build 28106.

w844.assumed: the iPhone 12-14 full-screen cell most reports and specs were written against
w844.verified: NOT his phone: the iPhone 12-14 cell (tools/ui/menu-screens.mjs ios-iphone-landscape-844) most reports were measured on
